messages:
sam-partnerships: Quick sync — we've got a model provider (NovaWeights) asking for marketplace listing + resell path. Need clarity on provenance, signing, and export gating. TL;DR: can we list them as a hosted SKU and allow cloud resellers + SI bundles?

maria-ops: Putting the checklist here: model card, provenance manifest, PGP signature of weights, license text (redistribution clause), export control self-attestation, test eval set. Is that right?

tara-legal: +1 on the checklist. Important: their license currently disallows commercial redistribution unless we negotiate an addendum. We need a written reseller addendum signed by the provider.

jonathan-engineering: For the hosted SKU we also need a quantized variant that passes our perf regression suite. If they provide only fp16 we should ask for a quantized dump or permission to quantize. Also: K/V cache interplay for deduped weights — minor notes.

lee-infra: From infra: for resellers and SI bundles we need a clear origin signature that our infra can verify during packaging. We prefer an HSM-backed signing key or a PGP-signed manifest that we can pin.

sam-partnerships: Tara — can legal draft a short reseller addendum template? We want minimal friction but must cover indemnity + export.

tara-legal: I can do a draft by EOD if we get the provider's base license and a short list of the SI/resellers they plan to allow. Need contact email.

maria-ops: Provider already sent license v1 and a contact (ops@novaweights.ai). I uploaded the weight checks to /shared/partners/nova/weights-checklist.txt.

jonathan-engineering: Heads up, their model uses an uncommon tokenizer that breaks streaming tokens. We'll need to run the streaming shim and maybe provide a compatibility wrapper for SDKs. Minor but affects release notes.

lee-infra: Packaging constraints: if we're enabling on-prem SI bundles, we must ship a signed manifest and a SHA256 artifact list. Example snippet we'd require:
```
manifest_version: 1
weights_sha256: <hex>
signature: <pgp-or-hsm-sig>
```
Please confirm provider can supply that.

sam-partnerships: Good. For timelines — target public listing (hosted SKU) + partner reseller availability in 6 weeks, joint announcement 8 weeks. Can ops/engineering/legal hit those?

maria-ops: 6 weeks is tight but doable if provider gives signed artifacts this week and legal moves fast. Ops will run the perf/quant tests in week 1.

jonathan-engineering: We need a nominal SLA matrix from the provider for dedicated/dedicated-on-reseller. Ask them to state expected latency p50/p95 on our reference instance (seq length 512).

sam-partnerships: I'll ask. Also propose embargo window: 2026-05-15 for partner channels, public announce 2026-05-22. Thoughts?

tara-legal: Embargo dates OK as long as reseller addendum signed before 05-15. Also need export self-attestation cleared by security before embargo lift.

lee-infra: We'll require the provider to rotate signing keys into our onboarding HSM by week 2 for SI bundle approvals. If they can't, we can accept PGP but need a longer review.

sam-partnerships: @nova contact looped in: ops@novaweights.ai — asking for license addendum, signed manifest, quantized weights or OK to quantize, and SLA numbers.

deploy-bot: deploy-notice: created partner-onboard/novaweights ticket #PW-1342 (assignee: maria-ops)

maria-ops: I'll own the ticket. Next steps: 1) tara to draft reseller addendum, 2) sam to request artifacts, 3) jonathan to prep compatibility shim, 4) lee to draft manifest validation script. Checkin Friday?

sam-partnerships: Friday checkin works. If any blocker pops up tag #exec-partnerships. Thanks everyone :rocket:
